T.note: Depreciation = total D&A less amortization of intangibles (cash-flow statement). Capex = cash capital expenditures (vendor-financing payments not included; the lag and shares absorb the timing). AT&T 10-K lives: network equipment and software 3-15 years, outside plant (fiber, cable) 10-40+, buildings 35-45. Capex tag changed in 2018 (PaymentsToAcquireProductiveAssets). DirecTV (2021) and WarnerMedia (2022) left the group, so the fit starts in 2023 and old vintages run off through the fitted legacy term.

DY.note: Depreciation = total D&A less amortization of intangibles; the set's dep_rate is depreciation ex amortization. Dycom fleet (trucks, equipment) 1-15 years, mostly 3-7; buildings up to 35.

MOD.note: Depreciation = total D&A less amortization of intangibles. Modine machinery 3-15 years, buildings 20-40. History includes businesses since sold (Performance Technologies), so the fit is looser.

INTC.note: Depreciation = total D&A less amortization of intangibles. Gross capex (partner contributions not netted: the consolidated fabs depreciate in full). Intel machinery 5 years, extended to 8 years for some production equipment from 2023 (10-K change of estimate); buildings 10-25 years. Construction in progress is very large (Ohio, Magdeburg paused), so building lags are long.
